notes_for_editor: Two sources only, both lists: the tnlandforms.us inventory row (WYT005: Ovilla, 1057 ft, Wayne, '7-22 removed') and a name-and-county list on Eastern US Lookouts. Neither gives a build date, builder, staffing, fire, or access record, and two web searches found no history for this tower. The inventory's 'removed' label is not defined on the page. A search result mentioned an Ovilla Volunteer Fire Department in Lawrenceburg; that is a fire station, unrelated to the tower, and was not cited. The Tennessee Division of Forestry site returned HTTP 403 and was not read. The 2015 multiple-property study is named in search snippets but was not opened. Story is short because the evidence is thin.
